name: getpeppr-docs-checks
description: Checks published examples by compilation, parsing and runtime scenarios. Export and webhook scenarios use loopback; validation and recipient checks use intercepted HTTP calls. No real credentials or getpeppr API calls are used. The only external request made by the checks fetches the public OpenAPI spec.

scripts.check: npm run check:examples && npm run check:snippets && npm run check:python && npm run check:shell && npm run check:postman && npm run check:routes && npm run check:export && npm run check:runtime
